The server builds from a clean copy and passes all 4 example cases in `node check.mjs`. The unit tests pass, and so did my own run of extra edge cases against the binary: 1 MiB round-trip, 200 parallel PUTs and GETs, bad keys, wrong methods, GET with a body.
